name: Chariot
summary: Adelaide ISP; built through acquisition: SA roll-up (OurWorld 1998; Cobweb, Newave, InterNex, Satlink, Pipeline, Box, Ompac, CNN, Universal; Picknowl 2002; Mr Bean, Better.Net, eCITE, Cyberwizards Mar 2003; Blue Pin/Northnet + Squirrel Net Aug 2003; Ledanet + Broadnet 11 May 2004) and a Queensland consolidation into the 'Chariot netconnect' brand (Qld Net, Technet 2000, Mackay Internet, Oznetcom by Mar 2005). FY2003-04 alone: 10 ISP acquisitions, ~32,000 customers. TPG took a controlling stake Feb 2007 but the Chariot netconnect brand continued under TPG/SP Telemedia until ~2010.

events.details: Little Adelaide dialup ISP; General Manager John Lindsay (1997-1999) built it into an ASX-listed company (CTI).
Acquired OurWorld Global Network's customer base (incl. ex-iiNet SA customers) from the liquidator; John Lindsay, GM 1997-1999, was previously GM of OGN.
Brand folded into TPG/SP Telemedia (TPG control Feb 2007).
